test_title: SSC CPO 2025 Official Paper (Held On 11 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What does the idiom "blow one's own horn" mean?

options.text: To remain silent in a conversation

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **To praise oneself excessively**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The idiom **"blow one's own horn"** means to boast or praise oneself excessively. (अपनी प्रशंसा करना)
 
 
• **Example:** He loves to blow his own horn about his achievements in the corporate world.
 
 
• The correct interpretation of this idiom reflects self-promotion or bragging about one's own accomplishments. (अपनी उपलब्धियों के बारे में डींग मारना)
 
 
• **Example:** Instead of blowing his own horn, he should let his work speak for itself.
